title: Whether a Lead-share bar was ever the right target

completion_criteria.text: The routing fix ships as agent description text rather than measurement: a stopping condition on architect and when-NOT-to-use clauses on all four Leads, generated from the spec files.
The 50 percent bar's origin is traced to the decision that set it, and what it was meant to detect is stated in that decision's own words rather than reconstructed after the fact.
The Lead share the architecture should produce BY DESIGN is derived from the roster's dispatch topology - a Lead that fans out to N makers implies a share - rather than assumed or asserted.
Whether a share statistic is diagnostic of delegation health at all is settled on evidence; retiring the measure entirely is an allowed and equally valid outcome.
A replacement target, or the decision to have none, is pinned BEFORE any corpus is re-read, so the conclusion cannot be fitted to the measured 24.23 to 26.60 percent.
The measured 24.23 to 26.60 percent is interpreted against whatever is settled, with the struck c5's negative outcome left standing regardless of what that interpretation concludes.

spine.active_goal: Answered and closed out. The share statistic is retired as non-diagnostic, and the routing fix shipped as agent description text rather than as measurement.
spine.next_step: MERGE PR 238 FIRST - it is open and human-gated, and its agent definitions are in force only while the checkout sits on fix/lead-agent-stopping-condition. Confirm by merge-base, not the MERGED label, then delete the branch. Only c1 remains here: a single read of decision 0579 stating what the retired bar meant to detect. Do not propose a replacement metric, a dispatch-counting hook, a validator or a Lead budget - 0613 rules them all out.
spine.last_session: Measurement dropped by user ruling; c2, c4, c5 struck, c3 and detour c6 met. Routing fix shipped as PR 238 with a drift-check red-then-green receipt. Ledger divergence investigated and REFUTED; three real defects filed upstream instead.

open_risks.text: Merge PR 238 to make the new agent definitions durable — they are in force only while the checkout stays on its branch, because the agents directory symlinks into this working tree
Cite decision 0521 by slug and never by bare number — two different decisions from two threads share that number, written 35 seconds apart by an unlocked allocator
Never collapse or merge the twin plugin data roots — convergence is per-project and incidental, and one project on this machine holds 70 decision records in a single root
Delete the pointer file to clear a stale active-thread, never a status churn — no MCP tool or CLI command clears it, because transition_thread throws before reaching its release line
Expect a thread id to be rejected as unknown mid-session — a second data root can answer a call, and re-sending the same id usually succeeds once the original store answers again

key_decisions.title: Retire Lead share as the target: it is a marginal statistic and routing appropriateness is conditional
Drop the routing measurement entirely: fix triggering with agent description text, not machinery
Number 0521 holds two different decisions; both are named here rather than renumbered
Never collapse the twin plugin data roots: convergence is per-project and one project would lose 70 records

out_of_scope: Re-measuring Lead share at any grain, Lead set or corpus - the measurement is settled, the instrument is shipped, and the statistic itself is retired.
Building routing measurement of any kind, including the three tree-based signals that were specified and then dropped - 0613 rules out hooks, counters, budgets, validators and gates.
Collapsing, merging or reconciling the twin plugin data roots, and patching the plugin cache, which any plugin update erases.
